description: Close a live project: its page stays readable with a "no longer looking for people" notice, it leaves Projects, Jobs and the sitemaps, every open role closes and pending applicants are told by e-mail. Always confirm with the user first (name the project) and only then call with confirm set to true.

confirm.description: Must be true. Ask the user to confirm before calling: the project leaves Projects and Jobs, every open role closes and pending applicants are told; those applications stay closed even if publish_project relists the project later.

project_id.description: The project's id (from list_projects or create_project).

name: close_project
title: Close project
